title: I Tried Target's New App Features to See If They Make Shopping Easier - Business Insider
summary: Target's mobile app, a key driver of the company's early digital business success, is facing increased competition as rivals enhance their app features. Despite this, Target continues to innovate with subtle integrations of AI to improve the shopping experience.
sentiment_reason: The article presents both challenges due to increased competition and positive developments from Target's innovations, leading to a neutral market impact.
